title: Postmaster Shipment Enquiry

sources.title: Find the Missing Letters
markers: If the letters are read and Danzo is blackmailed into paying more: 640 gold

summary: Quest evidence of Danzo’s Zhentarim dealings during Find the Missing Letters.

fields.Quest use: Open the recovered envelope and read this letter before confronting Danzo. The quest walkthrough reports a blackmail payout of 640 gp. Opening the envelope without reading leaves a harder DC 20 bluff. Failing the confrontation check can make Danzo hostile.
fields.Acquisition: In the Bundle of Letters on the roof of the Open Hand Temple, X −45, Y −4.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
